Atbash Cipher Tool

Apply the Atbash mirror cipher (A↔Z, B↔Y…) — encoding and decoding are identical.

Atbash is its own inverse — applying it twice restores the original.

📖 How to use

  1. Type or paste text.
  2. Press Convert to apply Atbash.
  3. Copy the result.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How does Atbash work?

The alphabet is reversed: A becomes Z, B becomes Y, C becomes X, and so on.

How do I decode?

Encoding twice returns the original text, so the same button both encodes and decodes.

Where does Atbash come from?

Atbash dates back to ancient Hebrew scribes; its name comes from the first, last, second and second-last Hebrew letters (Aleph-Taw-Beth-Shin).
